stages.title: Get grilled
stages.text: The agent asks you questions one at a time until every design decision is settled. Matt does this before every change.

stages.title: Write it down
stages.text: Turn the conversation into a spec, then split it into thin tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges.

stages.title: Implement
stages.text: Build the tickets test-first at the seams you agreed on, and finish with a two-axis review.

stages.title: Open the PR
stages.text: A PR body with a summary, before/after evidence and a call on how risky the merge is.

stages.title: Tune the setup
stages.text: Ask what slowed the session down and fix your environment, starting with the worst problem.

helpers.title: Helpers that join in on their own
helpers.text: These are model-invoked. You don't type them. The agent loads them when the work calls for it, though you can also name them directly.
